description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.comment class, which represents a DOM comment node within the CKEditor framework. It extends the base CKEDITOR.dom.node class and provides methods for creating comment nodes and retrieving their outer HTML.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.comment
classes.description: A class representing a DOM comment node, extending CKEDITOR.dom.node, with methods to create comment nodes and get their HTML representation.

methods.description: Constructor function for CKEDITOR.dom.comment, creates a comment node with specified text and optionally associates it with an owner document.

methods.name: getOuterHtml
methods.description: Returns the outer HTML representation of the comment node, formatted as an HTML comment.
